test-case.name: Given_RingOnMotion_When_Reconciled_Then_NoRingBindingIsCreated
test-case.output: [Motion] A ring-* / outline-* utility on a Motion is ignored: the band is placed from the element's laid-out box, which a Motion's transform does not move, so a slide / scale / layoutId play would leave it behind. Wrap the Motion around a ringed Div instead.
